import shutil
import tempfile
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/44264/1_44264_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/44264_0_d4664bb3/1_44264_output.xlsx"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

# Load workbook and write dynamic formulas only in J7:N9
wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

percentages = [ws.cell(row=r, column=18).value for r in range(7, 10)]  # R7:R9

cached_values = {}

for row in range(7, 10):
    qty = ws.cell(row=row, column=7).value      # G
    start_week = ws.cell(row=row, column=8).value  # H

    for col in range(10, 15):  # J:N
        col_letter = get_column_letter(col)
        cell_ref = f"{col_letter}{row}"

        # Dynamic formula: checks if the report week is within the moving 3-week slot,
        # then applies the matching percentage from R7:R9.
        formula = (
            f'=IF(AND({col_letter}$6>=$H{row},'
            f'{col_letter}$6<$H{row}+ROWS($R$7:$R$9)),'
            f'$G{row}*INDEX($R$7:$R$9,{col_letter}$6-$H{row}+1),"")'
        )
        ws[cell_ref] = formula

        week = ws.cell(row=6, column=col).value
        value = ""
        if qty is not None and start_week is not None and week is not None:
            offset = int(week - start_week)
            if 0 <= offset < len(percentages):
                value = qty * percentages[offset]
        cached_values[cell_ref] = value

# Save once with formulas
tmp_formula = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".xlsx").name
wb.save(tmp_formula)

# Add cached formula results into the worksheet XML so both formula-aware
# and data_only readers can see the intended output.
tmp_final = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".xlsx").name
ns = {"main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}
ET.register_namespace("", ns["main"])

with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_formula, "r") as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_final, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)

        if item.filename == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
            root = ET.fromstring(data)
            for c in root.findall(".//main:c", ns):
                ref = c.attrib.get("r")
                if ref in cached_values:
                    # Remove any existing cached value
                    for v in list(c.findall("main:v", ns)):
                        c.remove(v)

                    value = cached_values[ref]
                    v = ET.SubElement(c, f"{{{ns['main']}}}v")
                    if value == "":
                        c.set("t", "str")
                        v.text = ""
                    else:
                        c.attrib.pop("t", None)
                        v.text = str(value)

            data = ET.tostring(root, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)

        zout.writestr(item, data)

shutil.move(tmp_final, output_path)
os.remove(tmp_formula)
